rows.label: weekly mission completion
rows.note: Rank 1 Shelter to Rank 2 Encampment; also rescues Chipper

conditions: Finishing the mission alone gives zero Stock; all weekly Stock comes from the bonus challenges and blue Stock crates.
Missions rotate Sneaky Sabotage, Junk Run, then Prison Break at Monday 00:00 UTC, advancing only after you complete the current one.
Known boss bugs (Sprag replaying her intro in Junk Run; an unfair Ven'kra Tel fight in Prison Break) can void a Deathless run.
bonuses: Deathless is worth exactly 30 Stock by itself and covers the Slaytra in one clean run.
Challenge progress carries over between runs since Echoes of Veilbreaker, so a bad run doesn't reset collectibles.
Blue Stock crates give 2 Stock each, up to 5 per run (10 Stock), and respawn on replay, so three quick extracted runs also make 30 without touching the challenges.

disclosures.title: Stock is shared across all of Chipper's stock
disclosures.body: Styanax parts, Afentis, Aegrit, Archon mods, ephemeras and Skaut all draw from the same Stock pool; the wiki prices every permanent item once at 980 Stock total, so buy the Slaytra first if you want it before the rest.

conditions: Kahl can't use your mods or loadout, and the machete you use in Sneaky Sabotage is only labelled "Machete"; playing with it there doesn't give you the weapon.
